description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

About the Role
We are looking for a Sales Engineer to join our team. This is a remote role based out of Madrid, Spain, reporting to the Senior Sales Engineering Manager in the Solutions Consulting department. In this role, you will serve as the technical pivot point for our sales process, presenting the Zscaler cloud security platform to prospective customers and translating their business goals into enticing, high-impact recommendations. As a trusted advisor, you will guide clients through their digital transformation journeys, gathering technical requirements and driving proof-of-concept engagements, presentations, and custom demonstrations that clearly articulate our value proposition while collaborating closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams to shape comprehensive account strategies.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Present the Zscaler cloud security platform to prospective customers to demonstrate clear business value
  • Set the technical vision and translate customer goals into enticing, relevant recommendations
  • Act as a trusted advisor to clients, guiding and aiding them through their transformational security journey
  • Gather customer technical requirements and promote the value proposition through presentations, demonstrations, and proof-of-concept engagements
  • Partner closely with Account Executives, cross-functional specialists, and extended teams to shape strategic account plans

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You're comfortable building the path as you walk it. You thrive in a dynamic environment, seeing ambiguity not as a hindrance, but as the raw material to build something meaningful.
  • You act like an owner. Your passion for the mission fuels your bias for action. You operate with integrity because you genuinely care about the outcome. True ownership involves leveraging dynamic range: the ability to navigate seamlessly between high-level strategy and hands-on execution.
  • You are a problem-solver. You love running towards the challenges because you are laser-focused on finding the solution, knowing that solving the hard problems delivers the biggest impact.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator. You are ambitious for the team, not just yourself. You embrace our challenge culture by giving and receiving ongoing feedback—knowing that candor delivered with clarity and respect is the truest form of teamwork and the fastest way to earn trust.
  • You are a learner. You have a true growth mindset and are obsessed with your own development, actively seeking feedback to become a better partner and a stronger teammate. You love what you do and you do it with purpose.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 5+ years of experience as a Sales Engineer or Systems Integrator
  • Deep knowledge of enterprise network or cloud security technologies
  • Proven experience working with Value Selling Methodologies
  • Demonstrated ability to produce high-impact presentations, technical demonstrations, and partner with sales teams to deliver proof-of-concept engagements
  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • Fluent proficiency in Spanish is required for this role

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience demonstrating or positioning AI-powered threat detection, predictive security analytics, or AI-driven data protection features to enterprise clients
  • Cloud Platform or other relevant industry certifications such as CISSP or CCNP, alongside domain expertise in SASE, Identity, Proxy technology, Cybersecurity, DLP, CASB, or CNAPP
  • Professional fluency in English combined with a proven track record of supporting and winning large enterprise accounts

#LI-LJ1

The range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire base salaries for this position across all Spain locations. Individual pay placement within this range is determined based on objective, gender-neutral criteria including job-related skills, relevant experience, and education or training. The base salary range listed for this full-time position excludes commission/bonus/equity (if applicable) and benefits.

title: Advertising Account Executive
description:
Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

About the Role

At 6sense, we're building one of the fastest-growing advertising businesses in B2B technology and looking for talented enterprise sellers to help fuel the next phase of growth.

This is a unique opportunity to join a rapidly expanding team within one of the industry's leading go-to-market platforms and play a direct role in shaping the future of B2B advertising. As an Enterprise Advertising Account Executive, you'll partner with enterprise organizations to help them leverage programmatic advertising, predictive intelligence, AI-driven insights, intent data, and audience activation to identify in-market buyers, accelerate pipeline, and drive measurable revenue growth.

This is an overlay seller role that partners closely with SaaS Account Executives to grow revenue across enterprise accounts, help customers unlock greater value from 6sense, and drive measurable pipeline and business outcomes.

We're looking for ambitious, driven sellers who want more than just another sales role. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a high-growth business, work alongside industry-leading GTM experts, and become a core contributor to one of the company’s growing revenue streams.

The ideal candidate thrives in fast-paced environments and is energized by helping enterprise customers achieve measurable outcomes, growing customer relationships, driving revenue, and contributing to the continued expansion of 6sense’s advertising business.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying advertising, media, or SaaS sales experience, with experience selling into enterprise organizations.
  • Experience selling B2B programmatic advertising, digital media, audience solutions, intent data, or related advertising technology.
  • Experience working with large or complex enterprise customers.
  • Demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales goals and successfully navigating complex sales cycles.
  • Ability to identify opportunities to grow media revenue within existing accounts by developing relationships, uncovering new use cases, and working across multiple stakeholders.
  • Strong consultative selling skills, communication skills, and business acumen.
  • Ability to articulate how advertising, audience activation, predictive intelligence, and intent data can contribute to pipeline and revenue outcomes.
  • Comfortable partnering with internal account teams and cross-functional stakeholders to develop and execute account strategies.

Preferred Experience

Preferred experience includes selling advertising, media, or marketing technology solutions into enterprise organizations and engaging marketing stakeholders such as CMOs, VPs of Marketing, Advertising and Media leaders, Demand Generation teams, and ABM leaders.

Ideal Candidate

  • The ideal candidate has experience selling B2B advertising, programmatic media, AdTech, or related marketing technology solutions and understands how advertising fits within a broader B2B go-to-market strategy.
  • This individual is comfortable engaging senior marketing buyers and can connect advertising investments to pipeline creation, account engagement, revenue growth, and measurable business outcomes.
  • They have demonstrated an ability to grow customer relationships by identifying new opportunities, building strong stakeholder relationships, and expanding adoption across accounts.
    They are curious, collaborative, motivated to learn, and excited about building their career within a rapidly growing area of 6sense.

Base Salary Range: $98,760.00 - $144,848.00. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO). #Li-remote

Notice of Collection and Use of Personal Information for California Residents: California Recruitment Privacy Notice and Policy

Our Benefits:

Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces.

We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to jobs@6sense.com.

We are aware of recruiting impersonation attempts that are not affiliated with 6sense in any way. All email communications from 6sense will originate from the @6sense.com domain. We will not initially contact you via text message and will never request payments. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official 6sense employee, reach out to jobs@6sense.com

  • Support the creation of scalable acquisition funnels by ensuring proper tracking implementation and gathering data insights

  • Actively participate in the testing loop by preparing new ad concepts, organizing creative assets, and setting up audience tests

  • Monitor campaign and funnel performance using our core tools (Voluum, GA4, internal dashboards) and promptly flag any critical changes or performance anomalies

  • Pull, clean, and organize performance data (CPA, ROAS, retention) to support weekly and monthly strategic reviews

  • Maintain and update internal reporting documents and dashboards

  • Support the creative briefing process by gathering performance data and communicating required asset changes and successful angles to the content team

  • Collaborate with Product and Content teams to assist in the launch and testing cycles for landing pages, focusing on conversion rate improvements

  • Research and document potential new acquisition opportunities (networks, formats, tools, etc.)

  • Stay up-to-date on platform rules, policy changes, and algorithm shifts

  • Grow our user base: Your analysis and execution will directly contribute to hitting our goal of growing from 40 million to 100 million users

  • Launch new channels: Handle the foundational setup (tracking, ad setup) required to successfully test and launch completely new advertising platforms

Hard Skills

  • Technical aptitude: Ability to quickly learn and master new software, dashboards, and platform interfaces

  • Analytical & Creative ability: You have a good eye for what makes an ad hook effective, and you possess strong analytical skills (comfortable with data/Excel) to learn how to translate data into creative briefs

Nice-to-Haves

  • Knowledge of basic online marketing metrics (CPM, CTR, CPA)

  • Familiarity with any analytics or tracking tool (e.g., GA4, Voluum, or basic platform reporting setups)

  • Experience in sensitive or regulated verticals (e.g. dating, femtech, telehealth, etc.)

Soft Skills

🗣 Good communication skills: You are fluent in English and can clearly articulate thoughts and findings

🎯 Driven & Accountable: You are motivated, take full ownership of your tasks, and commit to achieving goals

⚡️ Action-oriented: You thrive in a fast-paced environment and prioritize execution and speed

🧠 Curious & Detail-oriented: You are meticulous with data and possess a strong desire to learn the why behind performance

🧢 Humble learner: You actively seek feedback and are eager to grow in the field of paid acquisition

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

  • Assist in documenting and implementing systems designed to streamline creative testing speed and reduce fatigue

Partnership Management & Learning:

  • Build initial rapport with key traffic source representatives, assisting the Senior team in managing communications and reporting performance

  • Research and document potential new acquisition opportunities (networks, formats, tools, etc.)

  • Stay up-to-date on platform rules, policy changes, and algorithm shifts

Challenges You’ll Tackle

In this role, you will be instrumental in supporting our growth goals. Specifically, you will:

  • Help us scale fast: Execute the daily campaign changes needed to grow our budgets while constantly watching the data to keep our cost targets (CAC/ROAS) in check

  • Grow our user base: Your analysis and execution will directly contribute to hitting our goal of growing from 40 million to 100 million users

  • Launch new channels: Handle the foundational setup (tracking, ad setup) required to successfully test and launch completely new advertising platforms

  • Improve conversions: Run A/B tests on landing pages and funnels to find opportunities to make our campaigns more efficient

  • Be the link for creative: Take performance data, translate it into clear suggestions for our creative team, and ensure the new ad concepts are launched and tracked correctly

Your Qualifications

Hard Skills

  • Experience level: Minimum 1 year of experience required in performance marketing or user acquisition

  • Platform curiosity: You have explored and understand the basic structures of major ad platforms (like Meta, TikTok, Google, etc.)

  • Technical aptitude: Ability to quickly learn and master new software, dashboards, and platform interfaces

  • Analytical & Creative ability: You have a good eye for what makes an ad hook effective, and you possess strong analytical skills (comfortable with data/Excel) to learn how to translate data into creative briefs

Nice-to-Haves

  • Knowledge of basic online marketing metrics (CPM, CTR, CPA)

  • Familiarity with any analytics or tracking tool (e.g., GA4, Voluum, or basic platform reporting setups)

  • Experience in sensitive or regulated verticals (e.g. dating, femtech, telehealth, etc.)

Soft Skills

🗣 Good communication skills: You are fluent in English and can clearly articulate thoughts and findings

🎯 Driven & Accountable: You are motivated, take full ownership of your tasks, and commit to achieving goals

⚡️ Action-oriented: You thrive in a fast-paced environment and prioritize execution and speed

🧠 Curious & Detail-oriented: You are meticulous with data and possess a strong desire to learn the why behind performance

🧢 Humble learner: You actively seek feedback and are eager to grow in the field of paid acquisition

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of 100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist (1year Limited Term)
description:
Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

Job Overview

The Talent Acquisition Specialist (TAS) is responsible for supporting global full-cycle talent acquisition. The TAS interfaces with a wide variety of stakeholders including HR, people leaders, candidates, vendors, and partner organizations. In addition, the TAS contributes to the creation of selection materials, employer branding, onboarding, and special HR projects as required.

Key Responsabilities

  • Full-Cycle Recruitment: Conduct high-volume talent acquisition including job posting, sourcing, screening, and interviewing.
  • Offer Negotiation & Compliance: Negotiate employment offers ensuring compliance with starting salary practices and pay equity.
  • Talent Pipeline Development: Apply industry-leading techniques to source passive and active candidates; Create and maintain talent pipelines for key opportunities.
  • Candidate Experience Management: Champion a positive candidate experience for internal and external job applicants.
  • Vendor & Partnership Management: Liaise with recruitment agencies, marketing/social media partners, and employment-focused community organizations.
  • Employee Referral Program: Champion the internal Employee Referral Program including promotion, tracking, and reporting.
  • Selection Materials Development: Create industry-supported, role-specific selection materials in conjunction with managers.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Undergraduate university degree (Specialty in HR) and 1-3 years' related experience with initial and on-going training

    OR College Diploma/Degree and 4-6 years related experience +substantial on-going job -related training.

  • Knowledge of labour legislation in LATAM.
  • Experience working in a global or multi-country organization, particularly within the life sciences, pharmaceutical, or contract research industry preferred.
  • Strong oral and written communication skills.
  • Excellent time management and organizational abilities.
  • Ability to maintain strict confidentiality.
  • Fluent in the reading, writing and speaking of English (additional language skills are preferred).

What We Offer

In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs:

  • Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees
  • Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility)
  • One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.)
  • Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year!
  • Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September
  • Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition!
  • Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment
  • Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team!

Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.

Our Services

  • End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support
  • Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading
  • Precision medicine and biomarker solutions
  • Real-world evidence and clinical consulting
  • Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio

How to Apply

To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Equal Opportunity and Accessibility

Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to recruitment@alimentiv.com.

Compensation

Additional Information

Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams

Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. Our hiring process always includes direct engagement with a recruiter or hiring manager, and we will never ask for sensitive personal information early in the process.

Official communication will only come from company email addresses containing "@alimentiv.com". If you are contacted about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender's email address and confirm that you are being asked to apply on this website. If something doesn't feel right, we encourage you to verify before responding. If you believe you have been the victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report it.

title: Go-To-Market (GTM) Specialist
description:
Mindera is an enterprise technology and consulting company that combines advisory, strategy and delivery to solve complex challenges and enable transformation for our clients. Alongside our strategic advisory, our product engineering, capability, and specialist teams take ownership of critical business functions for our clients - spanning AI, cloud, data, mobile, and more - to deliver modern and reliable solutions.

For over 12 years, and as a team of 1,300+ talented people, we’ve been building, running, and improving the technology that powers some of the world’s most well-known brands. We also care about building a more inclusive future through technology. With our annual Tech Camps, Mindera School, Upskilling, neurodiversity programs and Code Academies, we facilitate everyone’s learning process - regardless of gender, colour or background to learn skills in tech - so they have the same opportunity to become whomever they wish: consultant, engineer, designer, product lead, tester, teacher, and more.

We are looking for an Go-To-Market (GTM) Specialist to join our global marketing team. In this role, you will help develop and deliver our commercial GTM strategy in close cooperation with the marketing, business development and vertical teams. This role requires an output and impact driven focus on complex tech services and influencing the enterprise pipeline.

Here we encourage the use of AI to assist with related tasks. If you need to, or plan to use AI, please be transparent with us when you're using it, to avoid issues and misunderstandings that can either: impact your chance of securing the role or impact your success at Mindera.

National and international expected traveling time varies according to project/client and organizational needs: 0%-15% estimated.

💪 How you’ll make an impact:

  • You are an AI champion who leads by example and you keep up with the latest development in AI in order to experiment with its applications in AI-native marketing.
  • You like to kickstart new projects, strategies, programmes and ways of working that create value based on the needs and requirements of the team.
  • You are comfortable spotting gaps in an assigned task and improving it by making and explaining professional judgement calls.
  • You have a preference for impact and a focus on ‘getting things done’ - this includes chasing people, opening doors, and not letting projects stall.
  • You are an excellent communicator in meetings and shares opinions openly, including giving and receiving constructive feedback or disagreement.

Requirements

🌿 What You Will Be Doing

  • Play an active, collaborative role in the global marketing team and support the various responsibilities the team has including regional support, content production, social media and reporting.
  • Integrate with the business development team to define key objectives and deliver high impact GTM work.
  • Develop the website as a commercial asset by upgrading structure, messaging, lead capture and conversion elements in collaboration with the website design and development teams.
  • Build case studies and client stories with account teams to discover key ideas for marketing campaigns, collateral production and new commercial website pages.
  • Manage, report and optimise paid advertising and outbound (email, LinkedIn, CRM, automation) strategies to develop effective ABM generation campaigns
  • Produce commercial collateral like slide decks, lead magnets and one-pages to support the business development team.
  • Identify and codify core products and services in collaboration with the business development team and work with the content team to launch and promote those.
  • Take initiative in developing new category, product, service offers to attract new clients and establish a competitive advantage in the market
  • Identify where AI can improve productivity in marketing, sales, research and reporting, then build the solutions.

🛠️ What We're Looking For

  • You have proven experience in B2B marketing
  • You can demonstrate significant impact in owning and delivering marketing programmes
  • At least 1 year of experience inside a startup would be a bonus
  • You have basic knowledge and literacy in software engineering
  • You have strong stakeholder management skills across a matrixed organisation
  • Hands-on experience across various website, social media, and CRM platforms
  • Having examples of previous AI-native marketing work (internal tools, workflows, agents, etc) is essential

Benefits

🎊 What’s in it for You?

  • £50,000 - £60,000 per annum DOE
  • Flexible working arrangements
  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays. After 2 years you are entitled to 1 additional day/ year up to 30 days
  • Annual profit distribution
  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Shared Parental and Adoption leave and pay
  • Enhanced pension scheme (up to 8% matched)
  • Growth opportunities, including access to Udemy
  • Private Medical Healthcare with Aviva
  • A dynamic, innovative, and supportive work environment, where your ideas and contributions are valued
  • Opportunities for professional development and career advancement within a global company
  • Annual company team-building trip, Anniversary and Christmas party
  • Electric Vehicle leasing scheme
  • Retail Discounts
  • At our offices we have a wide range of snacks and drinks to keep you fed and healthy
  • Conference Budget
  • Cycle to Work scheme

🫂Why Mindera?

At Mindera, we use technology to build products we are proud of, with people we love.

We believe diverse teams build better products. Mindera is a place where you can be your authentic self, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, or background. We strive to create an environment where everyone feels they belong and has an equal opportunity to grow.

Most of all, you get to work with a group of great people in a politics free environment where the whole team owns the project together. Our culture reflects our lean and self-management mindset, encouraging colleagues to take risks, make decisions, collaborate openly, and communicate with everyone.

Freedom and responsibility go hand in hand, and we value commitment, feedback, and empathy. We are proud of our work and love learning about everything as we navigate an Agile, Lean, and collaborative environment.

Curious to know more? Check out our Blog and our Handbook!

With offices located across Portugal,United Kingdom,United States,India,Romania,Brazil,Morocco,Spain,Australia, Vietnamjoin us as we expand and influence the future of software engineering worldwide.

title: Sales Closer (Healthcare)
description:
Job Title: Sales Closer (Healthcare)

Position type: Part-Time (with full-time opportunity)

Work hours: 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM Pacific Time

Work days: Monday to Friday

Salary: $6 - $7 per hour

Job code: CP-BH

Workplace: Remote

Preferred Candidate Location: Philippines

Our client, a U.S.-based medical aesthetics practice, is looking for a Sales Closer to drive patient engagement, convert inquiries into booked appointments, reactivate inactive leads, and close treatment package sales.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives in sales, enjoys building relationships, and is motivated by measurable results. You'll play a key role in growing the practice by connecting with prospective and existing patients, following up on sales opportunities, and creating a welcoming, professional experience.

The ideal candidate is a proven sales closer with strong appointment-setting skills, a warm and confident phone presence, and the persistence to turn leads into paying customers.

Experience in medical spas, aesthetics, or healthcare is highly preferred, but strong sales professionals from other industries are welcome to apply. Spanish fluency is also highly preferred but not required.

The position starts at 20 hours per week, with the goal of transitioning to full-time as the practice grows. You'll receive direct training, sales scripts, and guidance to help you succeed.

Key Responsibilities

1. Lead Follow-Up, Appointment Conversion & Sales Closing (Top Priority)

  • Follow up with new inquiries and convert prospective patients into booked appointments.
  • Proactively reconnect with inactive patients, lost leads, and previous inquiries to generate new sales opportunities.
  • Conduct outbound calls and consistent follow-ups to encourage appointment bookings and treatment purchases.
  • Explain available treatments and packages using approved information and sales guidelines.
  • Confidently ask for the sale and help close treatment or package purchases.
  • Send secure payment links, monitor payment status, and follow up on outstanding deposits or purchases.
  • Maintain a warm, persuasive, and professional approach throughout the sales process.
  • Track lead conversions, appointment bookings, and sales performance against agreed goals.

2. Phone Coverage & Patient Communication (Top Priority)

  • Answer incoming and overflow calls using RingCentral.
  • Respond to patient inquiries promptly and professionally.
  • Provide accurate general information about services, appointments, and next steps.
  • Build rapport with prospective and existing patients through friendly, confident communication.
  • Direct clinical or other specialized inquiries to the appropriate staff members.
  • Document important call details and ensure timely follow-ups.

3. CRM Management & Administrative Support (Top Priority)

  • Maintain accurate patient and lead information in Aesthetic Record CRM.
  • Update lead statuses, document calls, and track follow-up activities.
  • Schedule appointments and maintain an organized practice calendar.
  • Monitor appointment readiness and coordinate necessary follow-ups.
  • Organize sales pipelines and identify leads requiring additional outreach.
  • Provide general administrative and back-office support as needed.

Sales & Lead Management

You'll work with an established database of prospective and existing patients, including:

  • Approximately 5–10 new leads per day, depending on marketing activity.
  • An existing database of approximately 1,000 contacts for follow-up and reactivation.
  • Leads generated through marketing campaigns, social media, email, and other practice channels.

You will not be responsible for sourcing or purchasing lead lists. The client provides leads through Aesthetic Record.

Outbound outreach and lead reactivation will be especially important during the initial part-time arrangement. Lead volumes may increase as marketing campaigns expand, and prompt responses to new leads will be a key priority.

Tools & Platforms

  • Aesthetic Record CRM: Lead management, patient records, appointment scheduling, and follow-up tracking. Training will be provided.
  • RingCentral: Incoming and outgoing calls, patient communication, and sales outreach.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently converting qualified inquiries into booked appointments.
  • Proactively reactivating inactive leads and generating treatment sales.
  • Following through on sales opportunities, payment links, and outstanding deposits.
  • Maintaining professional, welcoming communication with every patient.
  • Keeping CRM records, lead statuses, and follow-up activities accurate and updated.
  • Meeting agreed appointment conversion and sales performance goals.
  • Managing responsibilities independently and adapting to the practice's evolving needs.

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

  • Proven sales experience with demonstrated closing ability.
  • Hands-on experience with appointment setting, lead follow-up, and sales conversion.
  • Experience conducting outbound calls, proactive outreach, and cold calling.
  • Ability to reactivate inactive leads and confidently pursue sales opportunities.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Strong phone etiquette with a friendly, warm, persuasive, and professional approach.
  • Confidence explaining products or services, overcoming objections, and asking for the sale.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail when maintaining CRM records and tracking follow-ups.
  • Ability to manage multiple leads, prioritize opportunities, and work toward performance targets.
  • Willingness to learn the client's treatments, packages, sales scripts, and established processes.
  • Familiarity with customer confidentiality and willingness to follow HIPAA requirements.
  • Proactive, persistent, self-motivated, reliable, and comfortable working independently.
  • Willingness to transition from part-time to full-time as business needs grow.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience in medical spas, aesthetics, healthcare sales, or a related industry.
  • Familiarity with Aesthetic Record CRM or similar medical spa/aesthetics platforms.
  • Experience selling treatments, service packages, memberships, or other high-value offerings.
  • Experience managing large lead databases and reactivation campaigns.
  • Experience handling patient inquiries, appointment scheduling, and front-desk support.
  • Spanish-English bilingual proficiency is highly preferred but not required.

Candidates with strong sales closing experience from other industries are encouraged to apply. Proven sales ability and excellent English communication are more important than industry-specific experience or bilingual proficiency.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We're looking for someone who is:

  • A Confident Sales Closer: Comfortable asking for the sale, overcoming objections, and turning inquiries into paying customers.
  • Persistent & Results-Driven: Motivated to follow up consistently and convert inactive leads into new opportunities.
  • Warm & Personable: Creates a welcoming experience while building trust and rapport with prospective patients.
  • Proactive & Independent: Takes ownership of the sales pipeline and identifies opportunities without constant supervision.
  • Highly Organized: Maintains accurate CRM records, schedules, and follow-up activities.
  • Adaptable & Coachable: Learns new systems and services quickly and applies feedback effectively.
  • Reliable & Accountable: Consistently follows through on commitments and works toward agreed performance goals.

Basic Requirements

  • Must be proficient in speaking and writing clear, professional English.
  • Must have relevant sales experience, including appointment setting and closing.
  • Must be comfortable handling inbound and outbound calls.
  • Must be available Monday–Friday, 10:00 AM–2:00 PM Pacific Time.
  • Must be open to potentially increasing working hours to full-time.
  • Must be able to submit an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).
  • Must be available for video meetings with camera on when required.

Technical Requirements

  • Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
  • Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
  • Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
  • Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
  • Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.
  • Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

title: Customer Success Intern
description:
About Bask Health

Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.

We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Our teams work closely across product, engineering, customer success, sales, and company leadership to bring new capabilities to market and continuously improve the platform.

At Bask, we value people who are curious, take initiative, and enjoy learning how businesses work. Our customers include entrepreneurs and e-commerce operators building their own businesses, and our Customer Success team helps them understand the software, solve problems, and make progress toward their goals. We believe hands-on experience, thoughtful questions, and a willingness to take ownership are important parts of professional growth.

About the Role

We're looking for a Customer Success Intern to support our Customer Success team and gain practical experience working with SaaS software, e-commerce merchants, and customer-facing operations.

This internship is designed for someone who wants to learn how Customer Success teams build relationships, support onboarding, improve product adoption, and help customers get value from software.

You'll work alongside experienced Customer Success Managers and other team members to assist with daily customer success activities.

You'll learn about Bask Health's platform, the businesses using it, and the processes involved in supporting customers after they sign up.

Bask Health provides software that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch and manage direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.

Our platform brings together merchant storefronts, patient questionnaires, checkout experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy-related processes, and other business capabilities.

You'll develop an understanding of the merchant-facing aspects of the platform.

You'll learn how entrepreneurs use Bask Health to launch and operate online businesses.

You'll become familiar with the customer journey from onboarding through ongoing platform adoption.

You'll observe how Customer Success Managers communicate with merchants and manage customer relationships.

You'll help organize customer onboarding information and track outstanding tasks.

You'll assist with preparing onboarding checklists and customer follow-up materials.

You'll help maintain accurate customer account records.

You'll update assigned information in approved CRM and customer success systems.

You'll assist with preparing customer meeting notes and documenting action items.

You'll help track follow-up commitments made during customer conversations.

You'll support Customer Success Managers with routine administrative tasks.

You'll learn how customer onboarding milestones are organized and monitored.

You'll help identify missing information or incomplete tasks that may delay onboarding.

You'll communicate with internal team members to clarify assigned responsibilities.

You'll participate in customer meetings when appropriate and approved by your supervisor.

You'll observe how Customer Success Managers ask questions to understand customer goals.

You'll learn how to communicate professionally with entrepreneurs and business owners.

You'll assist with routine customer communications under supervision.

You'll help prepare draft follow-up emails and customer-facing messages.

You'll ensure customer communications are reviewed when required by established procedures.

You'll help customers locate approved onboarding resources and support documentation when authorized.

You'll learn how different platform capabilities relate to merchant operations.

You'll develop familiarity with online storefronts, questionnaires, checkout processes, and other supported workflows.

You'll assist with organizing common customer questions and feedback.

You'll help identify recurring onboarding questions that could be addressed through clearer documentation.

You'll contribute to internal knowledge articles and customer education resources.

You'll help maintain organized onboarding guides and frequently asked questions.

You'll participate in reviewing existing support documentation for clarity and accuracy.

You'll help identify outdated instructions and bring them to the appropriate team.

You'll learn how Customer Success teams measure onboarding progress and product adoption.

You'll become familiar with customer engagement and retention concepts.

You'll help organize account information used in customer success reporting.

You'll assist with preparing internal summaries of customer activity when requested.

You'll help track assigned customer success projects and administrative tasks.

You'll learn how teams identify customers who may need additional support.

You'll observe how Customer Success Managers handle customer concerns and follow-up conversations.

You'll develop an understanding of the importance of accurate documentation and reliable communication.

You'll help identify opportunities to improve internal customer success processes.

You'll assist with organizing information for customer business reviews.

You'll help prepare customer account summaries and relevant background materials.

You'll support research on e-commerce businesses and merchant operating models.

You'll learn about common challenges entrepreneurs face when launching online businesses.

You'll become familiar with e-commerce concepts such as storefronts, subscriptions, checkout experiences, and customer acquisition.

You'll learn how SaaS platforms support business operations.

You'll help research customer education topics and relevant merchant resources.

You'll contribute to projects that improve onboarding consistency and customer communication.

You'll assist with organizing customer feedback for Product and Engineering teams.

You'll learn how customer feedback can influence software improvements.

You'll help categorize common merchant questions and recurring platform issues.

You'll document reported problems accurately when assigned.

You'll recognize when a customer question requires specialized technical assistance.

You'll escalate technical issues to experienced team members rather than attempting unauthorized fixes.

You'll learn how Customer Success and Technical Support teams collaborate.

You'll participate in internal meetings and training sessions when appropriate.

You'll ask questions to better understand unfamiliar workflows.

You'll take notes during training and apply what you learn to assigned tasks.

You'll receive feedback from experienced team members and use it to improve your work.

You'll develop stronger written communication and organizational skills.

You'll learn how to manage multiple assignments and prioritize tasks.

You'll communicate proactively when you need clarification or additional assistance.

You'll take responsibility for completing assigned work accurately and on time.

You'll be encouraged to share ideas for improving routine processes.

You'll work with a remote team and learn how to collaborate effectively through online tools.

You'll become comfortable using spreadsheets, CRM systems, project management tools, and internal documentation.

You'll learn the importance of maintaining accurate customer information.

You'll follow approved privacy, security, and information-handling procedures.

You'll access only the customer information necessary and authorized for assigned responsibilities.

You'll use designated systems when handling customer records.

You'll recognize when a request involves clinical, pharmacy, or compliance matters.

You'll direct those questions to the appropriate authorized teams.

You'll never provide medical advice, make clinical decisions, or independently approve regulated activities.

You'll learn how to maintain professional boundaries when supporting customers.

You'll develop confidence communicating with internal teams and, when authorized, external customers.

You'll understand how Customer Success Managers balance customer needs with internal processes.

You'll learn how strong customer relationships are built through communication, organization, and follow-through.

You'll gain exposure to the practical challenges of supporting growing e-commerce businesses.

You'll develop an understanding of how customer onboarding, adoption, and retention connect.

You'll contribute to projects that help the Customer Success team work more efficiently.

You'll participate in discussions about customer challenges and opportunities for improvement.

You'll learn how to identify actionable information from customer feedback.

You'll help prepare documentation that supports consistent customer experiences.

You'll be encouraged to take initiative within the responsibilities assigned to you.

You'll receive guidance while gradually developing independence in routine tasks.

You'll build practical experience that can support a future career in Customer Success, account management, customer operations, or SaaS.

You'll contribute to a team environment that values curiosity, accountability, and continuous learning.

We're looking for someone who is interested in e-commerce, software, and working directly with businesses.

You don't need previous professional Customer Success experience, but you should be organized, dependable, comfortable using technology, and willing to learn.

Experience running an online store, working in customer service, completing a business-related project, or participating in an internship would be valuable.

Success in this internship means learning the platform, completing assigned work accurately, supporting the Customer Success team, communicating clearly, and developing practical skills through hands-on experience.

What You'll Do

  • Support Customer Success Managers with daily team activities.
  • Learn Bask Health's merchant-facing platform and customer workflows.
  • Assist with customer onboarding coordination.
  • Help track onboarding milestones and outstanding tasks.
  • Maintain accurate customer account records.
  • Update assigned information in approved CRM and customer success systems.
  • Prepare customer meeting notes and action items.
  • Help track customer follow-up commitments.
  • Assist with drafting customer communications under supervision.
  • Participate in approved customer meetings and onboarding discussions.
  • Help organize customer onboarding resources and documentation.
  • Support the maintenance of internal knowledge articles and FAQs.
  • Identify recurring customer questions and documentation gaps.
  • Assist with organizing merchant feedback and support information.
  • Help prepare customer account summaries and internal reports.
  • Learn how customer engagement, adoption, and retention are measured.
  • Support research on e-commerce businesses and merchant operations.
  • Become familiar with storefront, checkout, and subscription workflows.
  • Assist with customer education and onboarding improvement projects.
  • Help organize customer feedback for Product and Engineering teams.
  • Document assigned customer questions and reported issues accurately.
  • Escalate technical questions to experienced team members.
  • Participate in Customer Success training and internal team meetings.
  • Learn how Customer Success and Support teams collaborate.
  • Maintain organized task lists and project documentation.
  • Communicate proactively when assignments require clarification.
  • Follow established customer communication and escalation procedures.
  • Follow privacy, security, and information-handling requirements.
  • Escalate clinical, pharmacy, and compliance matters to authorized teams.
  • Contribute ideas for improving routine customer success processes.
  • Complete assigned projects accurately and on time.
  • Develop practical skills in SaaS Customer Success and e-commerce operations.

Requirements

  • Current student, recent graduate, or early-career candidate interested in Customer Success, business operations, or SaaS.
  • Strong interest in learning how Customer Success teams work.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate professionally with internal team members and customers.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to complete assigned tasks accurately and on time.
  • Comfortable learning and navigating web-based software.
  • Basic familiarity with email, spreadsheets, and online collaboration tools.
  • Willingness to learn CRM and customer success management systems.
  • Interest in e-commerce, entrepreneurship, and online businesses.
  • Ability to follow instructions and ask questions when clarification is needed.
  • Strong willingness to learn new processes and tools.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and follow-up responsibilities.
  • Comfortable receiving feedback and applying it to improve performance.
  • Strong sense of accountability for assigned work.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.
  • Professional and respectful communication skills.
  • Ability to maintain accurate notes and documentation.
  • Willingness to follow established customer communication procedures.
  • Understanding of the importance of privacy and secure information handling.
  • Ability to recognize when a request requires escalation.
  • Strong curiosity and willingness to investigate unfamiliar topics.
  • Availability to collaborate during agreed U.S. Eastern Time internship hours.
  • Comfortable working in a growing software environment.
  • Positive attitude toward learning, teamwork, and professional development.

Nice to Have

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Previous internship experience in customer support, Customer Success, or business operations.
  • Experience working in a customer-facing role.
  • Familiarity with Shopify, BigCommerce, or other e-commerce platforms.
  • Personal experience operating a Shopify store, TikTok Shop, Amazon business, or other online store.
  • Experience participating in an entrepreneurial or student-run business.
  • Familiarity with direct-to-consumer business models.
  • Experience using HubSpot, Salesforce, Zendesk, or similar tools.
  • Experience maintaining spreadsheets or tracking project tasks.
  • Familiarity with Google Workspace or Microsoft Office.
  • Experience preparing meeting notes and follow-up summaries.
  • Experience assisting with customer onboarding or software training.
  • Familiarity with online storefronts, checkout processes, and subscriptions.
  • Experience conducting business research or organizing customer information.
  • Experience creating written guides, presentations, or documentation.
  • Experience working with remote teams.
  • Interest in healthcare technology or telehealth software.
  • Experience working in a startup or small business environment.
  • Strong interest in building a career in SaaS Customer Success.
  • Experience completing relevant school projects or independent business initiatives.

title: Patient Access Specialist
description:
The Patient Access Specialist reflects the mission, vision, and values of NMHC, adheres to the organizations Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Responsibilities:

  • Consistently practices Patients First philosophy and adheres to high standards of customer service. This includes setting an example to peers, coworkers, etc. by fostering a team atmosphere.
  • Responds to questions and concerns.
  • Forwards, directs, and notifies Team Lead or Operations Coordinator of extraordinary issues as necessary.
  • Maintains patient confidentiality per HIPAA regulations.
  • Provides exceptional customer service to patients which establish a positive first impression of Northwestern Medicine.
  • Exceeds all consumer requests and alerts management of issues or concerns that require escalation.
  • Correctly identifies and collects patient demographic information in accordance with organization standards.
  • Interacts with various hospital departments and physicians offices to effectively schedule and direct patients through the NMHC systems in a patient/customer friendly manner.
  • Reaches out to patients to schedule an appointment as defined.
  • Performs medical necessity checks as necessary for scheduled services, communicates options to patient if appointment fails.
  • Informs patients of any issues with securing the financial account for their encounter.
  • Completes out-of-pocket estimations as requested by patients.
  • Provides training and education as needed.
  • Manages work schedule efficiently, completing tasks and assignments on time.
  • Completes other duties assigned by manager.
  • Cross-training between various departments will take place to ensure coverage.
  • Participates in Quality Assurance reviews to ensure integrity of patient data information.
  • Uses effective service recovery skills to solve problems or service breakdowns when they occur.
  • Utilizes department and hospital policies and procedures to complete assigned tasks.
  • Adheres to all department policies and compliance requirements.
  • Avoids putting patient in financial or safety risk.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Communication and Collaboration:

  • Communicates information to the patient regarding questions about physician referrals, insurance referrals and consultations.
  • Collects authorization numbers in appropriate systems as applicable.
  • Provides professional and constructive environment for communication across units/departments and resolves operational issues.
  • May attend intra/interdepartmental meetings which involve walking within NM Campus.
  • Communicates customer satisfaction issues to appropriate individuals.
  • Demonstrates teamwork by helping co-workers within and across departments.
  • Communicates effectively with others, respects diverse opinions and styles, and acknowledges the assistance and contributions of others.
  • Interacts with internal customers to provide excellent support service to staff in departments which provide direct patient care.
  • Accommodates all levels of communication ability.

Technology:

  • Utilizes multiple online order retrieval systems to verify or print the patients order.
  • Verifies insurance eligibility and benefit levels through the use of online tools (NDAS, ASF, etc.) or over the phone as necessary.
  • Completes accurate handoff instructions and notes to scheduling staff, by noting appropriately in Epic.
  • Demonstrates ability to use all computer applications efficiently and to the capacity needed in this position.
  • Runs real time eligibility (RTE) on all patients to verify insurance and follows out of network policies as applicable.
  • Sends quality Epic Messages/Telephone encounters that are descriptive and grammatically correct.

Efficiency, Process Improvement, and Business Growth:

  • Proactive in preventing issues with patient visit by double checking type of test, preps required, assuring no conflict with other tests, verifying time and location, communicating relevant information, verifying documenting order retrieval in notes for check-in person, ensures there are no duplicate patient records.
  • Understands minimum data set required for a complete registration, collects and verifies critical data and updates that information into registration system.
  • Understands departmental and individual quality metrics.
  • Proactively analyzes account activity, identifies problems, and initiates appropriate actions/resolutions.
  • Evaluates procedures and suggests improvements to enhance customer service and operational efficiency.
  • Participates in departmental quality improvement activities.
  • Provides ideas and suggestions for process improvements within the department.
  • Monitors registration and scheduling, including insurance verification to ensure processing within prescribed quality standards.
  • Adjusts processes as needed to meet standards.
  • Uses organizational and unit/department resources efficiently.
  • Acts as a training resource for new staff and a resource for coworkers, sharing process and workflow information.
  • Understands that schedule may change to reflect shifting business needs.
  • Evolves and learns as healthcare policies change.

EOE including Disabled and Veterans.

Required:

  • High School diploma or equivalent.
  • 2-3 years customer service or medical office experience.
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
  • Proficiency in computer data-entry/typing.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to read, write, and communicate effectively in English.
  • Basic Computer Skills.
  • Ability to type 40 wpm.
  • Ability to multi-task.
  • Customer service oriented.
  • Excellent organizational, time management, analytical, and problem solving skills.

Preferred:

  • Additional education.
  • Additional language skills.
  • Healthcare finance and/or healthcare insurance experience.
  • Knowledge and experience in a healthcare setting, especially patient scheduling and/or registration.

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Background Check

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check. Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

Benefits

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.

Click on or copy and paste URL to your browser to view detailed benefits information

Please refer to the Benefits Eligibility by Employment Classification to determine benefits eligibility for job postings.

If sign-on bonus is included in a job posting eligibility is as followed: Internal employees and rehires who left Northwestern Medicine within 1 year are not eligible for the sign-on bonus. Exception: New graduate internal employees seeking their first licensed clinical position as a Registered Nurse at NM may be eligible.

At Northwestern Medicine, every patient interaction makes a difference in cultivating a positive workplace. This patient-first approach is what sets us apart as a leader in the healthcare industry. As an integral part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to join our quest for better health care, no matter where you work within the Northwestern Medicine system. We pride ourselves on providing competitive benefits: from tuition reimbursement and loan forgiveness to 401(k) matching and lifecycle benefits, our goal is to take care of our employees. Ready to join our quest for better?

title: WC Claim Representative II
description:
SUMMARY

This is the intermediate level of the claim handler career path. Handles moderate to difficult claims. Exercises progressively more discretion in the determination of compensability of claims. Considers many factors in the determination claim reserves. Negotiates and settles claims within given authority.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

  1. Verifies workers’ compensation coverage of employers and injured employees.
  2. Determines compensability under workers’ compensation by thorough investigation of the claim.
  3. Determines causal relationship between the reported injury and the incident to ensure appropriate payment of benefits.
  4. Facilitates return to work for the injured employee.
  5. Establishes timely and appropriate reserves based on the profile of the claim within given authority based on anticipated financial exposure.
  6. Documents specifics of claims with potential for subrogation recovery, including amount of potential recovery monies.
  7. Manages medical bills for non-indemnity and indemnity claims directly associated with the claimed injury.Approves payment based on knowledge of the treatment plan and medical support showing relationship of treatment to the injury.
  8. Concludes and closes files following resolution of claims to meet internal performance standards while complying with state legislation to avoid penalties and manage expenses.
  9. Negotiates settlements with attorneys or injured parties within given authority at the earliest possible point to bring cases to final disposition.
  10. Works closely with manager on complex files or files above settlement/reserve authority.
  11. Manages outside vendors to ensure cost containment efforts.
  12. Establishes and maintains effective working relationships with all internal and external customers.
  13. Stays abreast of changes in workers’ compensation statutes, case law and rehabilitation efforts/advancements in order to accurately interpret and apply relevant laws.
  14. Administers complex claims and catastrophic exposures within authority, including claims from dedicated large accounts.
  15. Exercises independent judgment to settle cases prior to mediation or litigation.
  16. Actively participates in agent/client relationship management.
  17. Assists in mentoring team members.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

Relevant combination of education and experience may be considered in lieu of degree.

  1. Bachelor’s degree in a related field. Continuous learning, as defined by the Company’s learning philosophy, is required. Certification or progress toward certification is highly preferred and encouraged.
  2. Three (3) years of experience in a workers’ compensation claims environment which provides the necessary skills, knowledge and abilities, such as experience in reviewing, investigating and closing workers’ compensation claims. Experience of handling claims in multiple jurisdictions preferred.Bilingual skills preferred.
    1. OR
  3. One (1) year of AF Group Claims Representative I experience that includes handling of difficult or complex claims.

QUALIFICATIONS

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES

  1. Ability and proficiency in the use of computers and company standard software specific to position.
  2. Knowledge of medical and legal terminology related to the work.
  3. Knowledge of workers’ compensation laws and regulations, including jurisdictional laws.
  4. Effective oral and written communication skills.
  5. Effective customer service skills.
  6. Ability to negotiate, build consensus and resolve conflict.
  7. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established deadlines.
  8. Attention to detail and analytical skills.
  9. Ability to work independently as well as within a team.
  10. Ability to make independent decisions.
  11. Ability to solve complex problems.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of personnel so classified. This job description does not constitute a contract for employment.

PAY RANGE:
Actual compensation decision relies on the consideration of internal equity, candidate’s skills and professional experience, geographic location, market, and other potential factors.
