title: Sales Development Representative (CST)
description:
About RoadRunner

At RoadRunner, our daily motivation is to accelerate the road to Zero Waste™ while delivering maximum value for our customers and communities through efficient, scalable, and sustainable waste operations. Our team cares deeply about each other and our planet, and we are dedicated to leveraging technology and innovation to modernize a vital industry with integrity, expertise, and a passion for creating a future where waste is a problem of the past™.

Technology, artificial intelligence, and data‑driven strategies are the backbone of our team of waste experts, enabling us to deliver streamlined, cost‑effective, and sustainable waste and recycling services. Since RoadRunner’s founding in 2014, we’ve helped thousands of customer locations nationwide achieve an average of 10–20% savings on their monthly waste bills while improving recycling efficiency. We’re proud that RoadRunner’s industry‑leading model and people‑first culture have been recognized by the 2023 SEAL Business Sustainability Awards, Pittsburgh Business Times’ Best Places to Work (2025), and Pittsburgh Inno’s 2022 Fire Awards.

Our Glassdoor reviews are fantastic (3.3/5 on 311 reviews), our CEO’s approval rating is 71%, and 65% of our reviewers would recommend working here. Our Indeed ratings have consistently improved as we’ve been expanding our teams (3.5/5 on 85 reviews) and we now have over 14K followers on LinkedIn.

***Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa.

Sales Development Representative (SDR) — Proven Cold Outreach Specialist(100% Work from Home State-Specific)

Look at this video to see what it is like to be a Sales Development Representative at RoadRunner Modern Waste + Recycling!

Start Date: Monday, January 4th, 2027.

Compensation: $60,000 On-target Earnings ($50,000 base salary ($24.04/hour) + $6,000 annual commission (uncapped) + $4,000 milestone bonuses)

Location: 100% Remote (Within approved states)

Minimum Requirement: Associate degree + 1 year of high-volume sales experience

Your Mission

Ready to scale your sales career at a fast-growing industry disruptor? RoadRunner is revolutionizing the $100B+ waste and recycling management sector through cutting-edge technology and sustainable innovation. We are searching for an ambitious, high-performing Sales Development Representative (SDR) to spearhead our top-of-funnel growth.

This role is designed for a proven outbound prospector who thrives in a fast-paced environment. As the catalyst of our revenue engine, you will connect with high-value business targets, showcase our market-leading solutions, and book qualified meetings for our Account Executives. We back your ambition with elite ongoing training, top-tier tech stacks, and a clear path for rapid promotion.

Your Impact: What You'll Do

  • Drive High-Volume Prospecting: Execute strategic multi-touch cadences combining targeted cold outreach, personalized email campaigns, and modern social selling techniques to build a robust pipeline.
  • Articulate Modern Value Propositions: Educate mid-market decision-makers on how RoadRunner’s proprietary platform drives cost efficiency and meets critical sustainability metrics.
  • Fuel Strategic Revenue Growth: Partner directly with Account Executives by booking high-intent, qualified discovery calls that directly impact team targets and pipeline revenue.
  • Master Sales Operations: Maintain impeccable data integrity and lead management in Salesforce to optimize conversion rates and streamline outreach strategies.
  • Commit to Elite Mastery: Actively participate in continuous sales coaching, call shadowing, and skill-building sessions to refine your pitch and advance your sales career.

Who You Are: Our Ideal Candidate

  • Proven Track Record: Associate degree paired with 1+ years of quota-crushing performance in high-volume, outbound cold calling and direct sales.
  • Consistent Top Performer: Demonstrated ability to reliably hit and exceed core KPIs, activity targets, and monthly revenue quotas.
  • Unstoppable Grit: High-energy, resilient mindset with a proven ability to turn objections into conversations and sustain relentless outbound momentum.
  • Data-Fluent Sales Mindset: Skilled at leveraging sales analytics, conversion tracking, and conversion ratios to continuously optimize performance and pitch effectiveness.
  • Tech-Stack Mastery: Hands-on experience navigating modern CRM ecosystems, with direct proficiency in Salesforce preferred.

What Sets You Apart:

  • Metrics-Driven & Competitive: Possess an owner's mindset, driven by performance leaderboards, uncapped incentives, and personal growth goals.
  • Resilient & Adaptable: Maintain strong momentum and high confidence through objection handling and dynamic sales interactions.
  • Growth-Oriented Coachability: View continuous feedback as a leverage point to sharpen your methodology and fast-track career advancement.
  • Proactive Problem Solver: Stay curious, adaptable, and eager to master both industry trends and modern sales technologies.
  • Persuasive Communicator: Possess exceptional active listening and verbal communication skills, with the ability to quickly build rapport with key decision-makers.

What We Offer: Industry-Leading Compensation & Benefits

Generous Compensation:

  • $50,000 base salary (24.04/hour)
  • $6,000 Target Uncapped Commission Structure (unlimitedearning potential)
  • $4,000 milestone bonus
  • Clear promotional plan with opportunities for increased commission and bonuses

Top-Tier Health & Wellness:

  • Full coverage (100% employer-paid premiums) for Medical, Dental, and Vision plans.
    • 70% company-sponsored premium coverage for spouses and dependents.
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan featuring competitive company match contributions, plus access to complimentary expert financial planning guidance.
  • 100% paid Maternity Leave

Work-Life Integration & Time Off:

  • 100% Remote within approved states.
  • 15 Days of Paid Time Off (PTO), 2 Personal Floating Holidays, plus 10 paid Company Holidays.

Our Commitment to Your Growth: The SDR Success Roadmap

We provide a clear path to success with our structured, hands-on training.

  • Weeks 1–4: Foundation & Sales Enablement
  • Immersion in RoadRunner’s technology, value proposition, and competitive positioning.
  • Direct 1-on-1 coaching with dedicated sales trainers to calibrate call scripts, objection handling, and lead sourcing.
  • Launch initial outreach cadences and book your first qualified meeting.
  • Weeks 5–8: Strategy, Cadence & Optimization
  • Build multi-channel sales sequences tailored to high-value target accounts.
  • Participate in weekly group call reviews and strategy coaching to refine your conversion funnel.
  • Co-pilot sales strategy with assigned Account Executives to optimize lead-to-opportunity handoffs.
  • Month 3 & 4: Autonomy & High Performance
  • Manage and scale a fully operational pipeline to deliver consistent top-tier results.
  • Demonstrate full capability to drive revenue, overcome complex objections, and consistently achieve OTE milestones.
  • Position yourself for immediate promotional opportunities and bonus accelerators.

Next Steps:

  • Application Review by our Talent Acquisition team.
  • Prescreen Phone Call with a Recruiter (30 minutes).
  • Final Zoom Interview with our Talent Operations Lead (1-hour).
  • Offer & Onboarding.

We are excited to consider talented individuals from across the country. However, please note that we currently do not support candidates residing in the following states: Alaska (AK) / Delaware (DE) / Hawaii (HI) / Kansas (KS) / Louisiana (LA) / Maine (ME) / Montana (MT) / Nebraska (NE) / Nevada (NV) / New Mexico (NM) / North Dakota (ND) / South Dakota (SD) / Vermont (VT) / Wyoming (WY) / Puerto Rico (PR)

We thank all candidates for their interest in RoadRunner, but we cannot respond to everyone personally. Only those selected for an interview will be contacted. We look forward to reviewing your application!

RoadRunner is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer and is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. title: QA Testers Wanted to Jump on an AI Assistant project
location: Switzerland, Belgium, Luxembourg, Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland, Saudi Arabia and Israel
description:
About Tester Work

Tester Work is a global QA crowdsourcing platform that connects companies building digital products with a community of freelance testers worldwide. We help businesses improve their websites, mobile apps, and software by enabling real users to test products in real-world conditions and provide structured feedback.

As a tester, you’ll get access to flexible, project-based opportunities where you can earn money by executing test cases, exploring applications, and sharing usability feedback that helps improve digital products.

 

Overview

We are currently looking for QA testers to join our testing community. Once onboarded, you will gain access to our latest project and you'll be able to help us fine-tune a personal AI assistant developed by one of the biggest tech companies on the market. Besides, a variety of projects across different industries, including e-commerce, fintech, entertainment, and mobile applications, will also be available for you.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Follow step-by-step test cases to validate user flows (e.g., sign-up, login, checkout, payments)
  • Explore apps and websites to identify bugs or usability issues
  • Submit clear bug reports with steps, screenshots, or recordings when needed
  • Test region-specific features and localized functionality when required

 

Who This Role Is For

Based in one of the following countries:

  1. Switzerland (French and German speakers)
  2. Sweden (Native Swedish speakers)
  3. Luxembourg (English speakers)
  4. Belgium (Dutch and French speakers)
  5. Denmark (Native Danish speakers)
  6. Norway (Native Norwegian speakers)
  7. Finland (Native Finnish speakers)
  8. Saudi Arabia (Native Arabic speakers)
  9. Israel (Native Hebrew speakers)
  • Comfortable using websites, mobile apps and AI
  • QA/testing experience is a plus, but not required

 

What You Can Expect

  • Fully remote, flexible, project-based work
  • No fixed schedule, choose tasks based on your availability
  • Exposure to a wide range of digital products and industries
  • Opportunity to build QA/testing experience over time
  • Ongoing access to new testing cycles once onboarded

 

Compensation

  • Payment varies depending on project scope and complexity
  • Each assignment clearly defines tasks and compensation upfront
  • All payments are processed securely via PayPal, Wise or Upwork 

 

If you enjoy exploring apps, identifying issues, and helping improve digital products, this is a great opportunity to gain experience and earn flexible income as part of a global testing community.

title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish speakers in Spain
description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

 

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
description:
Job Title: Patient Care Advocate 

Job Location: Remote


About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview: 

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. 


What You’ll Do: 

  • Patient Enrollment & Eligibility: Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. 
  • Prescription Coverage: Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. 
  • Cost-Sharing & Payment: Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. 
  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. 
  • Refills & Continued Use: Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. 
  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. 


What We’re Looking For: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes
  • Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies
  • A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access
  • The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment

Success Factors for Working from Home 

  • Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. 
  • Ergonomics: A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. 
  • Reliable Internet Connection: Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. 
  • Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace: A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. 
  • Tech-Savvy: Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. 
  • Self-motivation & Independence: Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. 
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. 
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. 


Compensation & Perks 

  • Hourly Pay: $16.50 per hour 
  • Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. 
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. 
  • Cell Phone Benefits: $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). 
  • Generous Referral Program: Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. 
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. 
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. 
  • Work-from-Home Convenience: Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. 
  • Inclusive Culture: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. 

What Success Looks Like: 

  • Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance 
  • Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals 
  • High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience 
  • Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance 

Why Join Us? 

  • Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications 
  • Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors 
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package 
  • A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture 

Ready to Make an Impact? 

Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you! 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Prepared by: Global Head of Creative
Prepared Date: 10/1/26
Salary range: $85,000â$100,000


About Edconic

Edconic is a leading player in the alternative, experiential education space. We partner with the world's largest and most well-known brands to create and run schools that capture the legacy and value of each brand. Our students get truly unique, once-in-a-lifetime experiences that help shape their future and give them the skills they need to reach their goals.

The Role

We're looking for an experienced Front-End Developer to join our web team, which owns every Edconic digital property â from our school websites to landing pages and email templates. You'll work alongside designers, IT, and MarTech to build solutions that serve real business needs while protecting each brand's unique identity.

You'll be one of two developers on the team, working directly with our lead developer. That means real ownership of your work, a genuine voice in how we build, very little process overhead, and a codebase that is actively moving toward a modern, standardized WordPress stack. We value craft: fast pages and code that the next developer can read.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain public-facing websites, micro-sites, and landing pages in collaboration with our lead developer, IT, and MarTech.
  • Work with UX/UI designers to confirm the technical feasibility of designs, then translate them into polished, responsive pages that stay true to each brand.
  • Build and maintain custom WordPress themes across both of our stacks: modern block-based builds (ACF Blocks, core blocks, block patterns, theme.json) and established classic themes built on PHP templates, Advanced Custom Fields, and Sass.
  • Collaborate with our lead developer to shape the team's coding standards, tooling, and workflow, and help migrate our existing sites toward our new modern stack.
  • Stay current on emerging web standards and bring ideas to the table where they genuinely fit.

What You Bring

  • 4+ years of front-end web development experience, with strong skills in semantic HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, and WordPress.
  • The ability to build a custom WordPress theme from scratch using PHP templates and Advanced Custom Fields.
  • Strong CSS skills across Sass and modern native CSS (custom properties, nesting), and solid vanilla JavaScript.
  • Comfort working in Git/GitHub with pull requests and code reviews, and with npm-based build tools and the command line.
  • A habit of writing semantic, well-structured HTML that covers accessibility basics, with an eye for reuse, cross-browser compatibility, performance, and SEO.
  • Experience building and testing HTML emails.
  • Strong UX/UI sensibilities and a desire to sweat the small stuff.
  • A proactive, self-directed working style â you can run with a project independently and prioritize across several at once.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication â you're positive, collaborative, objective, and solution-oriented.

Bonus Experience

  • Modern WordPress block development: ACF Blocks, block.json, theme.json, and block patterns.
  • Composer, Bedrock or other Roots tooling (Sage/Blade, Trellis), Vite, or CI/CD with GitHub Actions.
  • Deeper accessibility experience (WCAG, ARIA, assistive-technology testing).
  • CRM and marketing automation integration (Salesforce, Pardot/Account Engagement).
  • Multilingual WordPress sites.
  • A modern JavaScript framework such as React or Vue.
  • UX or UI design, and design tools such as Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.


How We Use AI

AI-assisted development is a new and evolving part of our workflow. We use AI coding tools to speed up research, scaffolding, review, and routine work, and you're welcome to do the same.

AI is a tool here, not a substitute for expertise. You are accountable for every line of code that you ship, which means you must be able to write, review, debug, and explain production code entirely on your own. Expect to demonstrate those skills without AI assistance during the interview process.

Location, Travel & Eligibility

  • Fully remote within the United States. Occasional travel to our New York office may be required.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the US.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred (Computer Science, Interaction Design, Graphic Design, Communications, or a related field); equivalent professional experience is equally welcome.

Our Commitment

Edconic supports and embraces diversity and inclusiveness, and we encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement listed here. Reasonable accommodations are available to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the role and to participate in the interview process.

The above statements describe the general nature and level of work for this position. They are not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, and skills. Edconic reserves the right to modify this job description at its sole discretion.

description:
Über RCT Education

Die RCT Education gUG ist die gemeinnützige Bildungsinitiative der Erik RCT Filmproduktion GmbH aus Weinheim. Unser Ziel: Kindern, Jugendlichen und jungen Erwachsenen aus den einkommensschwachen Stadtteilen von Rundu, der zweitgrößten Stadt Namibias, Zugang zu digitaler Bildung und Künstlicher Intelligenz zu ermöglichen.

Dafür bauen wir vor Ort eine eigene Computer- und KI-Schule auf – mit Klassenraum, Satelliten-Internet, Präsenzkursen und Online-Unterricht aus Deutschland. Die Teilnahme ist für die Schüler kostenlos oder zum reinen Selbstkostenpreis.

Hinweis: Es handelt sich um ein unbezahltes Ehrenamt für die gemeinnützige RCT Education gUG. Wir suchen gerne mehrere Personen.

Wobei du mithelfen kannst

Wir suchen helfende Hände für alles, was ein junges gemeinnütziges Projekt braucht – du suchst dir aus, wo du dich am meisten einbringen möchtest:

  • Spendenakquise & Spendenmanagement: Unterstützer, Unternehmen und Stiftungen gewinnen, Spenden betreuen, Spenderkommunikation
  • Verwaltung & Organisation: Dokumentation, Planung, Koordination von Aufgaben und Terminen
  • Social Media & Marketing: Kanäle aufbauen, Inhalte planen, die Geschichte des Projekts erzählen
  • Kommunikation mit Namibia: Austausch mit unserem Team und unseren Partnern vor Ort in Rundu

Was du mitbringst

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (Englisch ist ein Plus für die Kommunikation mit Namibia)
  • Herz für Bildung und Lust, etwas Sinnvolles aufzubauen
  • Zuverlässigkeit und Eigeninitiative – du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung
  • Ein paar Stunden Zeit pro Woche, ganz flexibel
  • Bereitschaft, uns zu Beginn persönlich in Weinheim zu treffen

Was wir dir bieten

  • Namibia als Perspektive: Aktive Engagierte haben die Chance, bei Schulungsprogrammen vor Ort in Rundu dabei zu sein
  • Echte Verantwortung: Du bekommst deinen eigenen Bereich und gestaltest das Projekt von Anfang an mit
  • Persönliches Engagement- und Referenzzeugnis von Geschäftsführer Erik Faltermann
  • Portfolio-Material: Professionelle Fotos und Videoclips von deiner Arbeit für deinen Lebenslauf und LinkedIn
  • Einblick in professionelle Workflows aus der Filmproduktion bei Erik RCT
  • Arbeitsplatz im Erik RCT Headquarter in Weinheim
  • Flexibel: Zum Start treffen wir uns vor Ort, danach ist vieles auch remote möglich
  • Einladung zur Teamfeier von Erik RCT

Interesse?

Bewirb dich ganz unkompliziert über das Formular. Ein Lebenslauf ist gerne gesehen, aber kein Muss – erzähl uns einfach kurz, wer du bist und wobei du am liebsten helfen möchtest. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

title: AIT Propulsion Engineer
description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.


We are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run.

We want you as a talented AIT Propulsion Engineer to help us in our mission by supporting the integration and test of our products and equipment related to propulsion engines. That includes big engines (made in house), smaller thrusters, pumps, igniters etc…

You will be successful in this role if you are able to run these different tasks:

  • Manage the preparation of the equipment integration and functional tests, first for the PQM (Propulsion Qualification Model) and then on the FM (Flight Model)

  • Manage qualification campaigns on mechanical components

  • Procuring tools, FGSE, and test setups needed for AIT operations

  • Planning of integration procedures and schedule

  • Work closely with the design team to define the best design that would ease the integration and test

  • Running the assembly, integration, and testing operations on the capsule, with a tight-knit team

  • Running the functional tests of the components (internal TVAC, outgassing, hydrostatic tests, proof test, Cv characterization, etc.)

  • Clearly communicating and documenting integration and test results

  • Defining lessons learnt and making continuous improvement


What we would love to see from you:

In the role of AIT Propulsion engineer ideally, you will have the following:

  • Successful completion of an Engineering degree (Master or PhD) in mechanical science / propulsion or equivalent

  • An understanding of liquid propulsion systems

  • Having the double skills:

    • mechanical assembly for integration and potentially small tool / GSE design

    • electrical skill for test (data acquisition system for sensors, simple programming of python scripts, harness etc…)

  • Willingness to contribute to build and support a new team

  • Organized and rigorous

  • Hands-on approach

  • Inventive and problem solver

  • Team spirit


Skills and Behaviors

  • Good organizing and prioritization of tasks

  • Positive and flexible attitude to get the job done

  • Ability to communicate at all levels of the business

  • Demonstrates behaviors consistent with The Exploration Company’s core values of Commitment, Innovation, Trust, Quality, and Teamwork


Our mission

At The Exploration Company, we are democratizing space exploration i.e., by making it affordable, available, and open. Our high-impact team is driven by competence, impact, and efficiency. We are doers, team players, and problem solvers. Our culture is driven by technology, learning by doing, and passion for what we do.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?  

We'd love to hear from you if you wish to be a part of our journey. Please submit your CV now for immediate consideration and we will be in touch shortly. 
 
The Exploration Company is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Relocation assistance is provided for those willing to relocate including visa sponsorship where applicable.  


All offers are contingent upon the successful completion of a background check, which will be subject to the country, role, and project you applied for. By submitting your application, you acknowledge and agree that any offer of employment may be conditional upon successful condition of this check. The Exploration Company partners with Zinc Work Limited located in the UK (Zinc), a third-party provider, to ensure this process as efficient and transparent as possible.

If applicable, you will receive an email from Zinc upon acceptance of your offer with a link to a secure portal where you can provide the required information to Zinc.

title: Portfolio Accountant
description:
Access Your Potential.
Join us to create and deliver experiences that inspire people, spark connection, and bring imagination to life—while having a lot of fun doing it.

About the Job

We’re seeking a detail-oriented and organized Portfolio Accountant to join our Finance & Accounting team! In this role, you’ll manage the day-to-day accounting operations for an assigned Access territory, ensuring accurate financial records, timely reporting, and effective financial support for territory operations.

Working closely with territory leadership and the broader Finance & Accounting team, you’ll oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger transactions, month-end closing activities, and financial reporting. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working independently, solving problems, and building strong relationships with internal teams while keeping financial operations running smoothly.

What You'll Be Doing

Accounting & Financial Reporting

  • Manage day-to-day accounting activities for an assigned territory, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, and general ledger transactions.

  • Process supplier payments, client deposits, final payments, expense reports, and journal entries accurately and within established deadlines.

  • Prepare and maintain general ledger entries, account reconciliations, and supporting financial documentation.

  • Complete month-end closing activities, ensuring financial records are accurate and up to date.

  • Enter territory actuals into monthly budget comparison worksheets, review results for discrepancies, and flag variances for Controller review.

  • Monitor territory revenue, expenses, and cash flow to support accurate financial reporting.

  • Provide financial information and supporting documentation to the Controller and Finance & Accounting leadership.

Territory Accounting Support

  • Serve as a primary accounting resource for employees within the assigned territory.

  • Partner with territory leadership and internal departments to resolve accounting-related questions and discrepancies.

  • Review and submit territory-specific labor and staffing reports in accordance with established procedures.

  • Support territory budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting activities as assigned.

  • Ensure timely and accurate processing of financial transactions to support ongoing territory operations.

Compliance & Financial Accuracy

  • Maintain accurate accounting records in accordance with applicable accounting standards and company policies.

  • Assist with internal and external audits by maintaining organized financial records and supporting documentation.

  • Ensure accounting activities are completed in accordance with established procedures and reporting deadlines.

Training & Team Collaboration

  • Provide accounting-related guidance and training to new employees within the assigned territory as needed.

  • Collaborate with the Finance & Accounting team to ensure consistent application of established procedures, communicate accounting concerns, and escalate issues as appropriate.

  • Support additional territory-level accounting projects and responsibilities as assigned.

About You

We know that there’s no one in the world like you. And we know that you have a lot to offer the next company you work with. Below is a list of “nice-to-haves”, but don’t let those deter you from applying. Access believes that an inclusive team and culture is important. We seek applicants from all backgrounds to ensure we get the best, most creative talent on our team.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field preferred, or equivalent relevant experience.

  • 1–3 years of accounting experience preferred, ideally within hospitality, destination management, or a related industry.

  • Working knowledge of general accounting principles, accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger processes, and financial reconciliations.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience working with accounting or financial management systems (such as Yardi, MRI, Investran, or similar).

  • Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and commitment to financial accuracy.

  • Ability to independently manage recurring accounting responsibilities and consistently meet established deadlines.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and resolve accounting discrepancies.

  • Effective communication and collaboration skills when working with territory employees and internal stakeholders.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent Financial Accuracy: Territory financial records, reconciliations, and reporting are accurate, complete, and maintained with minimal corrections or rework.

  • Timely & Reliable Execution: Month-end close activities, financial transactions, and reporting requirements are consistently completed within established deadlines.

  • Effective Problem-Solving: Accounting discrepancies are identified and addressed promptly, with appropriate escalation of complex issues or financial variances.

  • Trusted Territory Partnership: Territory employees and leadership receive responsive, knowledgeable accounting support, with clear communication and dependable follow-through.

Why Access?

We’re a women-owned, award-winning destination management company with teams in cities coast to coast. For 50+ years, we’ve been producing high-impact events and experiences for global brands—and we’re just getting started.

 

CULTURE & EXTRAS

  • Certified as a Great Place to Work – 3 years in a row and counting!

  • 55+ years in the industry!

  • Women-owned and women-led

  • Fun, creative, and supportive culture

  • Focus on recognition and employee value – including annual and quarterly awards

  • Paid day off to serve your local community

  • Annual all-company retreat to connect, learn, and have fun together

  • Annual qualifier-based incentive trip for top performers (certain departments eligible)

  • Regional team outings

  • Monthly companywide meetings to connect, learn, and celebrate wins

  • Paid Sabbatical leave after 7 years of service!

 

COMPENSATION

  • Highly competitive total compensation, including strong base salary and quarterly bonuses

  • Very strong performance-based quarterly commission plans

  • 401k with company match (eligible after 1 year – up to 4% of salary matched, vested immediately)

  • Monthly cell phone stipend

 

WORK LIFE BALANCE

  • Flexible schedule opportunities

  • Generous PTO

  • Sick days

  • 9 full holidays

  • 5 half days off prior to holidays to unplug early

  • 2 floating holidays off to be used on holidays of your choice

  • ½ day Fridays in July & August (based on achievement of goals)

 

HEALTH, WELLNESS, AND FAMILY

PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT

  • State-of-the-art technology platforms and tools – including training

  • Experience with PCB layout

  • Experience characterising the mechanical and thermal properties of electronic systems

description:
About us

Salience Labs is developing optical circuit switching technology for AI infrastructure, aimed at reducing latency and cost in data centre networks. As we move towards deployment, you’ll have real ownership of your area and work alongside a highly technical team on a hard problem in AI infrastructure.

The role

You’ll join a multi-disciplinary research team in the UK to contribute to the development of III-V active components for integration with silicon photonics. You will help take devices from epitaxial stack and device design through fabrication with external partners, to characterisation, reliability and qualification.

What you’ll be doing

  • Contribute to the design and modelling of III-V active devices, including epitaxial layer structure, gain and power modelling, optical mode design, and electrical and thermal design

  • Help define device specifications for your area, translating system requirements into device design and integration targets

  • Contribute to mask design and tape-outs, including GDS layouts, test structures and design-of-experiment splits

  • Support fabrication runs with external epitaxy and foundry partners: follow process flows, review process and in-line data, and help resolve yield issues as the technology scales

  • Contribute to the characterisation strategy at wafer, chip and integrated-PIC level, including building and automating test setups

  • Analyse test data, correlate measured performance with design and process variations, and support design iterations to close performance gaps

  • Work with packaging and reliability engineers on burn-in, accelerated ageing, failure analysis and qualification

  • Share knowledge with colleagues and support the onboarding of new team members as the team grows

Essential requirements

  • PhD in physics, photonics, electrical engineering, optical engineering or a related subject with 2+ years’ relevant experience, or a Master’s degree with 4+ years’ relevant experience, including at least 2 years’ hands-on development of III-V optical amplifiers or semiconductor lasers, preferably in industry

  • Experience contributing to taking III-V devices from concept through design, fabrication and test, ideally including exposure to qualification

  • Good understanding of semiconductor laser and amplifier physics: optical gain, carrier dynamics, quantum-well design, noise, gain saturation and nonlinearities, thermal effects and polarisation dependence

  • Hands-on knowledge of III-V epitaxy and fabrication processes (e.g. MOCVD/MBE growth, lithography, etching, passivation, metallisation, facet/AR coating), and experience working with external foundries

  • Experience characterising amplifiers or lasers, including optical spectrum analysis, gain and noise measurement, wafer-level probing, temperature-controlled testing and test automation

  • Experience with simulation and layout tools for photonic devices, such as Lumerical, Photon Design, Crosslight, RSoft, COMSOL, KLayout, L-Edit or Cadence Virtuoso

  • Ability to work effectively with colleagues across design, process, test and packaging functions

  • Excellent communication skills, critical thinking, attention to detail and self-motivation

Nice to have

  • Experience integrating III-V active devices with silicon photonics, including coupling design between III-V and silicon waveguides

  • Experience mentoring or supervising junior engineers or students

  • Experience with reliability testing and failure analysis of III-V devices

  • Experience developing PDK building blocks or compact models for active devices

  • Programming experience (Python, MATLAB or C++) for simulation, test automation and data analysis

  • Knowledge of photonic packaging, including fibre coupling, thermal design and TEC control

  • A track record of high-quality patents and research papers

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As HR Generalist, you are the go-to HR contact for managers and teams in Crissier and Zurich. You turn company priorities into concrete HR actions: contract administration, onboarding, development, employee relations and compliance with Swiss employment law.

 
 

Responsibilities

Manager & Employee Partnership

  • Work in close collaboration with R&D management to support them in the design of the organization

  • Act as the single HR contact for Switzerland: present daily in Crissier, and a reliable remote partner for Zurich with regular visits

  • Give managers concrete, operational HR answers grounded in Swiss law, and address employee concerns promptly

  • Communicate with the teams with pedagogy to support and explain the organization

Stay aligned with the Paris HR team and group policy while remaining locally compliant

Local Compliance & Employment Law

  • Own compliance with Swiss employment law across the employee lifecycle (contracts, probation, working time, leave, termination) and adapt group contracts and HR policies to Swiss requirements

  • Manage relations with cantonal labor and migration authorities (Vaud and Zurich): filings, registrations, inspections

  • Handle employee representation obligations as headcount grows and keep leadership ahead of regulatory change

Payroll & Social Declarations

  • Own the monthly payroll cycle with our provider and Finance: validate variable inputs (absences, overtime, bonuses, joiners, leavers) and cross-check payslips

  • Ensure timely social and tax declarations and manage benefits (health, accident, pension)

HR Operations & Personnel Administration

  • Manage individual employee situations end to end: disciplinary procedures, conflict resolution, sensitive cases

  • Handle personnel administration (contracts, amendments, files, certificates), run absences in HiBob and produce HR metrics

  • Own work permit applications (G, B,L) for foreign nationals joining Crissier and Zurich: file with the DGEM, follow up until approval, and handle related cantonal and residence formalities

Onboarding, Offboarding & Mobility

  • Work with Talent Acquisition, who own recruitment: take over once an offer is accepted and run contracts, administration and onboarding for both sites

  • Handle offboarding with correct Swiss formalities and clear handover

 
 

Candidate Requirements

  • Master's degree or equivalent in HR, law, management or a related field

  • HR Manager certificate (Certificat de Gestionnaire RH, HRSE)

  • 10+ years in generalist HR or HR Business Partner roles, ideally in an SME or scale-up

  • Strong knowledge of Swiss employment law and social insurance; experience with work permits (G, B, L) is a plus

Skills

  • Credibility with managers and engineers; able to advise and decide

  • Rigor, confidentiality, autonomy and a taste for building processes

  • Comfort with an HRIS (HiBob) and reporting tools

Languages

  • Fluent French and English; Swiss-German is an asset for Zurich

Nice to have

  • Experience in defense, aerospace or deeptech, and with multi-site teams

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Clinical Growth SDR
description:
Prosper Health is on a mission to make life happier and healthier for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

Despite autism diagnoses increasing more than 5x in the past 25 years, autistic adults have been systematically overlooked. This has led to extremely poor outcomes, including high rates of co-occurring mental health conditions and a lower life expectancy. Prosper is here to change that.

We deliver specialized mental health services for autistic adults, covered by insurance. We've helped tens of thousands of people receive an autism diagnosis for the first time, work with neurodivergent-affirming therapists, and find belonging through community. Our outcomes meaningfully outperform traditional care for autistic adults, with substantially greater improvements in mood, anxiety, and quality of life.

Prosper is growing 3x year over year and is at mid-double-digit millions in run-rate revenue, with thousands of active clients and 1,000+ clinicians. We're a high-ownership, mission-driven team, building something that has never existed for autistic and neurodivergent adults.

About Prosper Health

Prosper Health is on a mission to make life happier and healthier for autistic and neurodivergent adults. We deliver specialized mental health services for autistic adults, covered by insurance. We're growing 3x year over year, at high-double-digit millions in run-rate revenue, with thousands of active clients and 600+ clinicians - and our culture is a unique mix of thoughtfulness, kindness, and high performance, integrating perspectives from clinicians and autistic self-advocates.

Four of our favorite principles we operate by: Clients First (choose what makes life better for the client, even when it's harder for us), Find a Way (ingenuity, scrappiness, and determination), Raise the Bar (grow deliberately; give and seek feedback), and Be a Good Person (kind, honest, and tell the truth even when it's uncomfortable).

Why this role matters to the mission

Demand for our care is growing fast, and we’re scaling our clinical team alongside it. This means every psychologist you bring in translates to more neurodivergent adults who get care. This role is the front door to growing the team that delivers Prosper’s mission. Your job is to reach qualified licensed psychologists, spark interest, and hand warm candidates to our clinical recruiting team for interviews.

The role

A fast-paced, phone-forward outreach role, but not a cold-calling grind. You'll work from Scout, our internal sourcing platform, which hands you a daily list of strong-fit psychologists and runs the sequencing, scheduling, and tracking. No list-building or chasing dead numbers. You're starting real conversations with clinicians about an opportunity many of them want (flexible, remote, insurance handled, steady referrals, mission-aligned) and booking the interested ones to meet our clinical team. We brought an all-star SDR onto the team earlier this year to build and prove this out - we are now looking to grow the team!

The people who thrive in this role enjoy connecting with people all day, stay energetic through many conversations, and are motivated by the bigger picture: every yes is another clinician helping autistic adults get care.

Commitment & Schedule

  • 40 hours/week, remote (US)
  • Contractor part-time to start, with a path to permanent based on performance
  • Target start: late-Oct 2026.
  • When you'll work: Weekday daytime, roughly 9AM to 5 PM ET, but open to timezone preferences (e.g., working PT hours)

What you'll do

  • Run ~600 outbound calls and ~1,000 emails per week through Scout's worklist (you make the calls/leave voicemails, emails are automated)
  • Have warm, consultative first conversations with licensed psychologists
  • Book interested candidates into interviews; log every outcome
  • Hit weekly activity and booking targets (live-connect rate, interviews booked)
  • Give us feedback on what's landing and what isn't with actionable notes, so we improve the message

Compensation

  • Expected annualized compensation of ~$80,000. Structured as a $25/hour base plus a performance bonus for every psychologist hired from your outreach. On-target performance lands you at $80k, with room for material upside above that. The bonus is uncapped and largely in your hands.

What we're looking for

  • 1–3 years in a high-volume outbound role: SDR/BDR, inside sales, or phone-based fundraising
  • Comfortable on the phone
  • Organized and consistent; you can run the same sequence 100x/week without dropping follow-ups
  • Clear written and verbal communication
  • Coachable and metrics-driven; you want to see your numbers and smash them
  • Bonus: experience recruiting clinicians, healthcare; familiarity with a CRM/sequencing tool

Nice to have (not required)

  • Exposure to healthcare, behavioral health, or clinical hiring

More about Prosper Health

  • Our culture is a unique mix of thoughtfulness, kindness, and high performance. We set ambitious goals and hold ourselves accountable to achieving them.
  • We always ensure that we integrate perspectives from experts in our space, including clinicians and autistic self-advocates.
  • Our team members come from places such as Bain, McKinsey, BCG, FirstHand Health, Rula, SeatGeek, Benchling, and schools like Harvard, MIT, Stanford, Yale, Penn, Dartmouth, Northwestern, Vanderbilt, and more.
  • Here are a few of our favorite operating principles:
    • Clients First - Our job is to solve real problems for our clients. Choose what makes life better for the client, even if it’s harder for us. Never lose sight of the person on the other side.
    • Find a Way - We use ingenuity, scrappiness, and determination to bend the world to accomplish our goals. We’re resourceful and do more with less.
    • Raise the Bar - We grow deliberately, by asking how things can improve and by giving and seeking feedback. We insist on the highest standards and keep pushing them higher.
    • Be a Good Person - Be kind, be honest, and make it fun to work here. Tell the truth even when it’s uncomfortable. Treat people with respect and go out of your way to do nice things for your teammates.

title: Junior Sales Development Representative (Early Career)
description:
Start your sales career where the world’s live experiences begin

Concerts, festivals, workshops, fundraisers, food crawls, comedy nights: people come together through events, and Eventbrite powers millions of them. We’re looking for a curious, driven, team-first person to be the first voice of Eventbrite for businesses and organizers, opening doors and building the pipeline that fuels Eventbrite.

This is a launchpad role. No prior sales experience is required. We’ll teach you the craft, and you bring the energy.

What you’ll do

  • Be the spark for our sales team. Join a fast-moving B2B sales team and help us scale. You’ll run and sharpen our outreach process, build relationships, and see your impact in real numbers.
  • Hunt for great opportunities. Research and reach out to promising creators through calls, email, and social, and build a pipeline of companies that could grow with Eventbrite.
  • Become an industry insider. Learn what motivates event organizers and decision-makers, what keeps them up at night, and how Eventbrite can help.
  • Know the product, and shape it. Learn to talk about our platform with clarity and confidence, and bring what you hear from customers back to our product teams.
  • Let the data guide you. Track your performance, spot patterns, and focus on the opportunities with the biggest payoff.
  • Make every interaction count. Earn trust with every call, email, and conversation.

What you’ll gain

  • Real training and a clear path forward. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. If you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects.
  • A front-row seat to a high-performing sales org. Learn from experienced reps and leaders in small, collaborative teams.
  • Meaningful work from day one. Your outreach directly feeds revenue, and you’ll have room to take initiative and be recognized for it.
  • Competitive pay. For early-career hires, base salary typically ranges from $70,173 to $91,661 in the US, plus performance-based variable compensation. Pay varies by location and expected impact, and grows as you do. For exceptional candidates, we may offer compensation that extends beyond the usual ranges to reflect their higher expected impact.
  • Flexibility. This role is fully remote.

Who we’re looking for

You don’t need a perfect résumé. We care about who you are and how you work:

  • Drive. You’re motivated, take ownership, and keep raising your own bar.
  • Curiosity and problem-solving. You ask good questions, learn quickly, and can break down a tough problem into clear next steps.
  • Team spirit. You share ideas and credit, jump in to help, and communicate honestly.
  • Resilience. You can hear “not right now,” learn from it, and keep going.
  • Strong communication. You can pick up the phone, start a conversation with a stranger, and make it worthwhile for both sides

Bonus points

Experience like this shows the traits that make great SDRs:

  • Event planning or a love of live events, from running one to simply never missing a show
  • Founding or running a business, side hustle, or student venture
  • Leadership or active involvement in student associations, clubs, Greek life, or volunteer organizations
  • Participation in academic or case competitions, hackathons, or pitch contests
  • Strong academic achievement, such as honors, scholarships, or a high GPA
  • Customer-facing work like retail, hospitality, campus roles, or internships

Our hiring process

If your application is a fit, you’ll have a couple of conversations with our team. We’ll explore your motivation, goals, and how you approach unfamiliar challenges. Interviews are a two-way conversation: a chance for us to get to know you, and for you to learn more about the company. So make the most of it; ask questions, dig into the way we work, and hear directly from the people you’re going to meet.
We set the bar high and won't extend an offer until we're convinced we've found the right candidate. This is why a job may stay open for months or be reposted several times.

ABOUT EVENTBRITE

At Eventbrite everyone is invited to be their whole self and we cultivate an environment to make sure that is feasible throughout the entirety of an individual's time at Eventbrite. We are committed to providing competitive, valuable and meaningful benefits and experiences for our employees to ensure we meet them where they are in life.

Cultivating a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture where all people are invited and belong is our top priority.

Employees can participate in resource groups and we offer global programming and training throughout the year to support a diverse and inclusive workplace. Read more about our Diversity and Inclusion work for our team, culture, and community.

BENEFITS

We offer comprehensive benefits and a wellness package above and beyond standard medical benefits to support our Britelings’ lifestyle.

Eventbrite's global benefit programs are designed to meet you where you are by offering resources and support for your health, well-being, finances, and family. This includes support in a remote environment, wellness allowance, Carrot family planning benefit, Origin Financial Planning service, and other offerings to ease the mind and body like Modern Health and BriteBreaks (generally the first Friday of every month off).

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

At Eventbrite, we are dedicated to fostering diversity, equity and inclusion. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, abilities and experiences to apply, and we make employment decisions on the basis of merit. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender reassignment, gender expression, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics, or any other legally protected characteristic.

If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during any part of the interview process, please let your recruiter know.

title: Paid Search Specialist (PPC) - Brazil
description:
Brafton is one of the world's leading content marketing firms, with offices in Boston, London, Toronto and Sydney. We aspire to continually raise the bar on what people consider "marketing content." We create result-focused strategies and content to drive SEO, social engagement and leads for our clients. Our teams continuously build expertise across new media formats, including video, blogs, infographics and web design.

This is a remote part-time contract position and is open to candidates in Brazil. Please include a resume in English.

Job Summary

The Paid Search Specialist works with Brafton's Director of Paid Search to create, polish, and execute successful PPC campaigns for our clients. He or she is an independent contributor who is comfortable launching, managing and optimizing campaigns.

The Paid Search Specialist has experience and expertise concerning every aspect of successful paid search efforts, including:

  • Account, campaign and ad group set up
  • Conversion tracking
  • Ad copy creation
  • Keyword research and selection
  • Budget management
  • Report creation and presentation

Reporting

This role is within Brafton's Paid Search team and reports into the Director of Paid Search.

Essential Job Functions

  • Research and create PPC campaigns:

  • Define keyword targets using various tools such as SEM Rush, SpyFu and Google Keyword Planner.

  • Advise on monthly campaign spend levels with the client's budget and goals in mind.

  • Create and/or revise ad copy and messaging.

  • Set up all components of campaigns and ad groups, including ensuring that all tracking is correctly and fully implemented.

  • Create and present compelling paid search proposals/audits.

  • Successfully execute planned campaigns - optimizing on a daily basis, as necessary, in Google Ads or any other tools and platforms in use.

  • Report on your results internally and externally in a clear, compelling fashion.

  • Collaborate closely with the account’s internal stakeholders and client contacts.

  • Bring a consultative approach to client campaigns, proactively ideating around and bringing forth the best possible paid search strategies to achieve client's marketing goals within budget.

  • Understand PPC best practices and provide insight through client deliverables.

  • Reliable management and reporting of monthly assigned PPC work.

Key Success Factors

  • Strong working knowledge of Google Ads, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Bing Paid Ads, conversion tracking and ROI based digital ad campaigns.

  • Demonstrated ability to successfully manage PPC campaigns for B2B/B2C clients.

  • Excellent client-facing communication skills (via phone, email, and video call).

  • The ability to create clear reports with riveting ROI narrative.

  • Strong interdepartmental and interpersonal skills.

  • The ability to work at a computer during standard working hours.

  • Meet scheduled and proposed deadlines.

  • The drive to consistently improve upon current ROAS and other PPC metrics (CTR, CPC, CPA, etc.).

Skills & Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.

  • Minimum two years of relevant work experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

  • Expert knowledge with the following technologies/software/programs/processes:

  • Google: Ads, Keyword Planner Tool, Search Console, Analytics, gMail

  • Basic Knowledge in or experience with similar tools such as: SearchAds360, SEMRush, Searchmetrics, Raven Tools, Buzzsuomo, Moz, Wordstream, Spyfu, or similar platforms.

  • Basic knowledge of PPC conversion tracking and ability to troubleshoot assignments.

  • Ability to adapt to new software and changes in the paid environment quickly

  • Ability to meet deadlines within a fast-paced marketing Agency environment

Time Breakout

20 percent client communication
20 percent internal communication
40 percent execution/production
10 percent reporting
10 percent miscellaneous

Compensation

Additional Information

title: Regulatory Affairs Specialist (m/f/d) – EU MDR & Digitalization – Remote
location: Austria, Belgium, Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Poland, Spain, Switzerland, United Kingdom
description:
It feels good to know that your work makes a difference. At Artivion, we develop and manufacture innovative medical devices and solutions for the treatment of aortic diseases. Together with surgeons around the world, we help save lives. We value the individual strengths of every team member, and your expertise can make a meaningful contribution to our mission. Bring your strengths to Artivion and grow with us.

We are looking for a

Regulatory Affairs Specialist (m/f/d) – EU MDR & Digitalization – Remote

Your Strength

  • University degree in science, engineering, or a related technical field, or an equivalent qualification
  • Ideally 3–5 years of professional experience in medical device Regulatory Affairs
  • Solid knowledge of the EU Medical Device Regulation (MDR), particularly Technical Documentation, conformity assessment, and regulatory compliance
  • Experience with Class IIa, IIb, or III medical devices; international regulatory experience is an advantage
  • Practical experience using AI-based tools for regulatory research, requirements analysis, documentation reviews, or similar activities
  • Strong affinity for digital technologies and structured data, with the ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into clear and verifiable criteria
  • Strong analytical skills, independent judgment, and a proactive, solution-oriented approach to improving regulatory processes
  • Very good English communication skills; German is an advantage

Your Contribution

  • Independently manage regulatory activities for new medical device approvals, maintenance of existing certifications, and ongoing EU MDR compliance
  • Prepare, review, and maintain Technical Documentation and regulatory submissions in accordance with applicable requirements
  • Assess regulatory requirements and product changes in close collaboration with international Regulatory Affairs teams and cross-functional experts
  • Address complex regulatory questions and support communication with Notified Bodies and Competent Authorities
  • Support international product registrations, regulatory lifecycle activities, and relevant quality management processes
  • Apply AI-based and digital tools to improve regulatory research, documentation reviews, consistency checks, and regulatory assessments
  • Translate regulatory requirements into structured review criteria and reproducible assessment processes, improving the traceability and reuse of regulatory information
  • Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce repetitive tasks, and improve regulatory process efficiency and quality
  • Critically evaluate AI-supported results for accuracy, completeness, and regulatory reliability, ensuring appropriate human oversight
  • Share practical experience and contribute to the responsible adoption of digital technologies within Regulatory Affairs

Our Strength

  • Independent and responsible role with the opportunity to actively shape and improve regulatory processes
  • Structured onboarding and ongoing support from experienced colleagues
  • An internationally successful medical device company with innovative products and a meaningful mission
  • An open, collaborative team and close cooperation with international colleagues and cross-functional experts
  • Fully remote work within our eligible European employment locations
  • The opportunity to contribute your ideas and actively drive digital transformation within Regulatory Affairs
  • Individual development opportunities and long-term career prospects

Location & Eligibility

This position is fully remote and open to candidates based in the United Kingdom, Belgium, the Netherlands, Germany, Italy, Poland, Spain, Austria, Switzerland, subject to applicable local employment arrangements and operational requirements.

Applicants must already have the legal right to work in their respective country of employment. Artivion does not provide visa sponsorship or work permit assistance.

title: Quality Control Specialist for AI/ML with Catalan Language
description:
About the Project

TSMG is looking for Quality control specialists to support an AI language project focused on improving speech recognition systems.

As a QC contributor, you will review completed language annotation tasks and ensure that AI-generated transcripts have been accurately converted into natural, readable display text according to the project guidelines. You will focus on identifying and correcting formatting, punctuation, capitalization, and text normalization issues.

What You Will Do

  • Review completed Display Transcription tasks for accuracy and consistency.
  • Compare the Display Transcription against the original lexical transcript and project guidelines.
  • Verify the correct use of:
  • punctuation;
  • capitalization;
  • numbers, dates, times, and currencies;
  • abbreviations and other text normalization rules.
  • Ensure that the original words and meaning have been preserved.
  • Identify and correct formatting or guideline-related errors.
  • Use the reference audio when necessary to verify ambiguous cases.
  • Apply project-specific quality standards consistently.
  • Provide accurate feedback and flag recurring issues when required.
  • Complete assigned QC tasks within project deadlines and productivity targets.

Requirements

  • Excellent written skills in the target language.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Good understanding of punctuation, capitalization, and written language conventions.
  • Ability to identify inconsistencies and errors in formatted text.
  • Ability to follow detailed guidelines and apply them consistently.
  • Basic computer skills and a reliable internet connection.
  • Ability to work independently and meet quality and productivity targets.
  • Previous experience in transcription, proofreading, quality control, annotation, or linguistic projects is a plus.
  • Training and project guidelines will be provided before the project starts.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to contribute to the development of AI and speech recognition technologies.
  • Flexible project-based work.
  • Clear guidelines and training before starting.
  • The opportunity to gain experience in AI language data and quality control projects.

title: Remote Customer Service Representative - Independent Contractor
description:
Company Description

ShyftOff is a flexible work platform that connects independent customer service professionals with leading brands across the U.S. With 26,000+ agents and growing, we're changing how people work by giving them more freedom, flexibility, and control over their earning potential.

Our platform offers 100% remote customer service opportunities, flexible scheduling in 30-minute increments, competitive compensation, and weekly payments. Whether you're looking for supplemental income or more consistent opportunities, ShyftOff makes it easy to find work that fits your life.

Work from home. Choose your hours. Earn on your terms.

Opportunity Description

ShyftOff connects independent customer service professionals with opportunities to support leading brands across industries like healthcare, financial services, insurance, retail, and technology.

As an independent agent on the ShyftOff platform, you'll have opportunities to help customers answer questions, resolve issues, and deliver exceptional service, all from the comfort of your home.

Compensation: $14–$20 per hour, depending on the program and applicable compensation structure.

Why Join ShyftOff?

  • Choose your own schedule: Select available shifts in 30-minute increments. Accept opportunities that fit your life, with no minimum hour commitments.
  • 100% remote: Provide customer service from home, without a commute or traditional office schedule.
  • Competitive earnings: Access opportunities with competitive, program-specific compensation rates disclosed before you commit.
  • Weekly payments: Get paid weekly for completed services, subject to program terms.
  • Multiple opportunities: Explore customer service programs across a variety of industries based on your qualifications and availability.
  • Priority Boarding: Top-performing, reliable agents receive priority access to available shifts, helping maximize their earning opportunities.
  • Work on your terms: Operate as a 1099 independent contractor with the freedom to choose which opportunities you accept.

Qualifications

We're looking for dependable, customer-focused independent professionals who take pride in delivering great service.

  • 3+ years of customer service experience preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities, empathy, and active listening skills.
  • Ability to fulfill accepted service commitments and meet client quality standards.
  • Comfortable navigating multiple computer systems and learning new technology.
  • Modern computer, USB headset, and reliable hard-wired internet connection (25 Mbps minimum).
  • Quiet, professional workspace suitable for customer calls.
  • Ability to complete program-specific qualifications, certifications, and onboarding requirements.

Location: Remote, United States only. Eligibility is limited to ShyftOff-approved states.

How to Get Started

  1. Sign up: Create your free ShyftOff account, complete your application, and submit your video interview.
  2. Explore opportunities: Review available programs, compensation rates, and qualification requirements to find the right fit.
  3. Get qualified: Complete any required program-specific certifications or onboarding.
  4. Choose your shifts: Select available 30-minute shifts that work for your schedule.
  5. Get paid weekly: Earn money by delivering great customer service.

Ready to Get Started?

Join 26,000+ agents who have discovered a more flexible way to work.

Your schedule. Your opportunities. Your success.

Sign up today at https://app.shyftoff.com/r/QPFQWH

Independent Contractor Disclosure: ShyftOff provides opportunities for independent contractors, not traditional employment. Agents choose whether to accept available opportunities and are responsible for their own taxes, equipment, and business expenses. Compensation, qualifications, and available hours vary by program and are not guaranteed. There is no fee to join ShyftOff. When you opt into a specific client program, you pay for that program's non-refundable background check ($40 for most programs; $199 for the Financial Services program). Program-specific certification and onboarding requirements are explained in the ShyftOff app.
